flags.message: This docket (25-1315) is a Rule 20 petition for an extraordinary writ of mandamus, not a certiorari petition, but the event carries kind=petition / stage=cert and so is scored under the cert vocabulary and the sal-v4 baseline-band risk-set rate (5.1%, OT2017-OT2024). All three candidates noted the mismatch and discounted far below the band anchor. The cert band population is a poor reference class for extraordinary-writ petitions, whose grant rate is far lower; a maintainer may want a petition-type marker on the event (or the statpack) so these cells can be separated at the leaderboard rather than inflating baseline-band skill.
